Please check, against the code that computes each, what the text says each number *is*, and answer in this issue with corrections only (silence = confirmed):
  > 
  > 1. **Clip paragraph (results.tex) and App. "The clip".** b<1 on the other seven datasets; unclipped PPI++ valid on census_income only from n = 1000; λ̂>1 in 71% of draws at n = 30 (gene_expression); the unclipped interval is narrower by 4.5% (n=100) and 2.3% (n=500) on gene_expression, 2.4%/1.5% on census_income; the formula's prediction is within 0.031 of the measured ratio on the real sets; the E9 sweep: agreement within 0.014 for n ≥ 300, unclipped saving 4% (b*=1.2) to 66% (b*=2) at n=100, N=10^4.
  > 2. **Strongest valid baseline.** Defined in the text as: of package and unclipped PPI++, the narrower among those coverage-valid in the cell (the narrower if neither is valid). Is that exactly `baseline_used` / `ratio_vs_valid_baseline`? Grid counts quoted: against the package 38 no gain / 12 undecided / 1 gain; against the valid baseline 39 / 12 / 0 (51 headline cells).
  > 3. **Break-even scoring (tab_breakeven_scoring).** 11 populations bracketed, 9 within factor 3 (synthetic+stress 10 bracketed, 9 within; real: 1 bracketed, a miss, 8 censored); and the floor ratios in measured units 0.967 (gene_expression) to 1.010 (forest).
  > 4. **Compute (App. "Compute and reproducibility").** 12.8 CPU-hours (1.6 synthetic, 5.6 real-data grid, 1.3 constructions, 2.8 side information, 1.5 failure regimes, 0.06 N/n slice), longest cell 22 minutes: does this include the unclipped re-runs, E9 and the finite-population check? If not, give the additional hours.
  > 5. **Finite-population check (new App. section).** The text says: disjoint draws without replacement; SD of PPI++ vs i.i.d. cell 0.942 (pred 0.968) at galaxies n=500, 0.828 (0.831) at n=3000, gene_expression n=3000 0.929 (0.910); galaxies n=3000 coverage 0.984 vs 0.950; census_income none. Is that what `finite_pop_check.csv` is, and does any headline/grid cell use the disjoint draw (I say all other cells are i.i.d. with replacement)?
  > 6. **T2 at the reference n.** Text: r = 1.009, 1.004, 1.004 on census_education, census_healthcare, alphafold; census_income 0.993 vs the package and 1.009 vs unclipped; all four no gain.
